flooding.title: Flooding

plain.high: There is a higher possibility of flooding here during heavy rainfall.
plain.moderate: Flooding can happen sometimes when rain is very heavy.
plain.low: Flooding is not common here, but be careful during very heavy rain.

flooding.whatItMeans: Low areas and blocked drains fill quickly when rain is heavy.
flooding.whoCareful: People near rivers, low ground, or poor drainage should be careful.
flooding.whatYouCanDo: Avoid low-lying roads during heavy rain. Keep drains clear. Follow local alerts.

air.title: Air quality
air.bad: The air may not be good today.
air.moderate: Air quality is okay for most people.
air.whoCareful: People with breathing problems, children and older people should be careful.
air.whatYouCanDo: Avoid staying outside for a long time if air is bad. Drink water. Keep windows closed if needed.

water.title: Water
water.limited: Water can be limited at times.
water.unavailable: Water information is not available right now.
